knowledge.purpose: Generic flex layout box that arranges its children in a row or column with gap, padding, and alignment
useCases: Group related blocks horizontally or vertically
Add consistent spacing between siblings without bespoke CSS
Wrap a child to apply a background or rounded corner
antiPatterns: Fixed-column responsive layouts — use layout.grid for those
Section-level page banding — use layout.section for full-bleed regions
Nesting containers many levels deep just to add margin — flatten the tree
knowledge.implementation:
Further anti-patterns:
- Creating an empty container then filling it in a later step — add the container WITH its children inline in one step (an empty + filled pair renders a blank duplicate)

Further use cases:
- Split a screen area into balanced left/right or top/bottom regions

Stacking law: on xs a row with two or more non-intrinsic children is drawn as a column; set keepRow: true only for ratio compositions where the side-by-side proportion is the design (mosaics, poster grids).

Breakpoint maps: direction, gap, padding, align, justify, wrap, maxWidth and minHeight may each be written as a breakpoint map ({"xs": "column", "md": "row"}); the engine (3.5) resolves it mobile first for the width the page is drawn at, before the container reads it, and the static first paint carries each breakpoint’s value. A breakpoint named above the one drawn leaves the prop at its default there.

jsonSchema.description: How the children flow: column (default) or row, and their reversed forms. May be a breakpoint map, resolved mobile first for the width the page is drawn at (engine 3.5): {"xs": "column", "md": "row"} stacks on a phone and sits side by side from 768px.

Space between children: a number of pixels or a CSS length. Unset → the theme base spacing. May be a breakpoint map, resolved mobile first for the width the page is drawn at (engine 3.5): e.g. {"xs": 8, "lg": 24}.

Inner padding in px. Defaults to 16 when the container paints a ground or border, to 0 when it only arranges — a pure layout container adds no space of its own. May be a breakpoint map, resolved mobile first for the width the page is drawn at (engine 3.5): e.g. {"xs": 8, "lg": 24}.
Cross-axis alignment of the children. May be a breakpoint map, resolved mobile first for the width the page is drawn at (engine 3.5): e.g. {"xs": "start", "md": "center"}.
Main-axis distribution of the children. May be a breakpoint map, resolved mobile first for the width the page is drawn at (engine 3.5): e.g. {"xs": "start", "md": "center"}.
A row wraps its children onto more lines instead of shrinking them. May be a breakpoint map, resolved mobile first for the width the page is drawn at (engine 3.5): e.g. {"xs": true, "lg": false}.
The box at least this tall: px or a CSS length. May be a breakpoint map, resolved mobile first for the width the page is drawn at (engine 3.5): e.g. {"xs": 240, "lg": 480}.
The box at most this wide: px or a CSS length. May be a breakpoint map, resolved mobile first for the width the page is drawn at (engine 3.5): e.g. {"xs": "100%", "lg": 960}.

props.name: center
props.description: With maxWidth set, centre the box in its parent (margin 0 auto). false keeps it at the start edge, or lets the block style place it.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: CSS aspect-ratio for the box, e.g. '16/9', '4/3', '1/1', '21/9', '3/2', or a number. Sets the ratio without forcing a fixed height.

props.name: backgroundGradient
props.description: A CSS gradient painted over backgroundColor (e.g. linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pw-color-primary), var(--pw-color-accent))).

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Border colour; defaults to var(--pw-color-border) when only borderWidth is given.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Border width in px; defaults to 1 when only borderColor is given.

props.name: keepRow
props.description: Exception that keeps the row from turning into a column on xs screens; for ratio compositions. Applied by the runtime.

jsonSchema.description: The landmark this box is: header (the bar or brand), main (the page content), footer (the legal line), aside, or nav (a group of links that navigates — give it a label). Unset: a plain box. Shell patterns set it; a page has one main.
The landmark's accessible name (aria-label), e.g. Sections. Only with landmark.

This box is the current item of a sequence (the step the reader is on). Bindable, e.g. "{{state.step == index + 1}}": true renders aria-current (currentKind, default step), so the state is not told by colour alone.
The aria-current value when current is true. Default step.
